methodPathParity.expected: The generated OpenAPI-to-MSW method/path inventory must be byte-current on Windows and Ubuntu for the same commit.
methodPathParity.actual: The report was generated on the Windows worktree using raw source-file bytes. Existing files used CRLF there but LF on Ubuntu, so the source SHA-256 values differed despite equivalent text content. The method/path registrations themselves reconciled locally at 154/154 with no missing, extra or duplicate mappings.
methodPathParity.rootCause: The generator hashed text files without canonicalizing line endings before SHA-256.
